name: Capsule Alice OTA 2026-11-23.13
body:
Reliable radio off and more stable OTA status.

- 'стоп', 'выключи радио', 'стоп радио' kill the capsula-audio|paplay radio pipeline
- OTA status shows daemon lock PID and backup location
- fix free-space parsing when choosing tmpfs snapshots
- remove wget -T flag: BusyBox on capsule 113 segfaults with it
- launcher only caps volume above 20%, never raises it from 5%/0%
- short commands end after 500 ms of silence instead of 900 ms
- 'Алиса, стоп' matches punctuation and common ASR misspellings
- launcher uses a lock so S50 and S97 cannot start two supervisors
- second capsule keeps its factory hostname; Bluetooth setup stays enabled
- includes radio, wake-word, pre-duck and periodic OTA fixes
